description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. Below the icon, dark grey sans-serif text reads "Check for updates" on two lines ("Check for" over "updates"). There are no axes, no axis labels or units, no ticks, no scale bar, no magnification, no legend, no colour scale, no data points, no sample labels, and no annotation values anywhere in the pixels. Nothing in the image refers to Fe–Mn–Al–C austenitic low-density steel, κ-carbide precipitation, Ti or V additions, aging conditions, or mechanical properties; the caption field for this figure was empty, so there is no caption text to cross-check. The image therefore carries no scientific evidence: it is a publisher metadata icon that has been routed as a figure. The only recoverable information is typographic — the two-word label "Check for updates" — and downstream agents must not treat this item as a data-bearing panel.
